summary: Backend-only retest of L02 LN-023-T01 cancelled-journey bug fix. order_journey_service.journey() now sets sisa=0 when status is cancelled/expired; the 'dibayar' step reads 'Pesanan dibatalkan — tidak ada tagihan' with done=false and state=cancelled. Ran the full test_l02_ln023_t01_ar_split_surfaces.py (extended) plus cross_surface_demo: 15/15 passed. A TEST_ SO (NET30, shipment_revenue JE 4jt, payment 1.5jt) set to cancelled and to expired returns outstanding 0, ar_ledger 0, exposure 0, cancelled true and current_step 'dibatalkan', for both the admin and the sales owner. No step contains 'Sisa tagihan'. Regression checks pass: after un-cancel, the split is restored (8.5jt = 2.5jt ledger + 6jt exposure, text 'Sisa tagihan'); status shipped keeps the ledger+exposure==outstanding invariant; the confirmed-unshipped stage is all exposure; all 11 demo orders and 7 customers satisfy the invariants.
critical_code_review_comments: journey(): when the order is cancelled, _ledger_split receives sisa=0, so ar_ledger and exposure both come back 0 even if a shipment_revenue JE was never voided. This matches Customer 360. Any un-voided JE on a cancelled order is a GL concern and does not belong to the journey.
